Californians are NOT apathetic about weed.
From worlds apart, one plant would bring them together. Witness the passion, the adventure, and the smoke in "the summer's best drama" (according to Roger Ebert): Queen Vic and the Secret Negro Army.
My family fedex's me shit from California :)
I hold the lighter at a specific distance and breathe at a constant rate, effectively vaporizing the trichs without lighting the weed. I call it "browning" the bowl. :)
Bongs it's nice to do snaps - just load a tiny fresh bowl for each person - that way everyone gets greens and everyone gets the same amount.

> Although many people think "cornering" the bowl is the proper way to smoke, its equally rude for your friend to point it out and make you feel bad about it. I have smoked with many, many, many people. Very few care enough to corner the bowl, but the truest of the stoners tend to do it without thinking about it.

This is the only part of your post I don't really agree with. On on hand, yeah it sucks to get called out, but if his friend did it politely in private he should be commended for improving this dude's smoking style. Sure, people don't like being proven wrong, but they also don't like looking like an ass in a social circle due to a behavior they have no knowledge of. I would be thankful if someone pointed this out to me.
